surfaces.title: Aditya Himawan — Portfolio / Blog
surfaces.direction: Studio Glass — a 2026 refinement of the live DAW-session hero. Warm hardware charcoal, signal orange, lamp amber and monitor moss; one liquid-glass instrument per view; Syne display, Space Grotesk UI, Geist body, Geist Mono silkscreen, Orbitron readouts.

review.feedback: Keep the current hero's DNA; brainstorm the other sections from the same theme; modernise the hero for 2026 while keeping it clean and simple.
changes: Kept the live DAW arrangement as the centrepiece and reframed it as one sheet of liquid glass over a warm ambient room.
Kept the name inside the profile clip, simplified the master strip to one fader plus a waveform, and made the dock the only transport.
Extended the studio vocabulary instead of switching themes: Works is a channel rack, Notes is a tracklist, the Reader is a solo view with a waveform scrub.
Added a section map and a review-notes frame so the whole signal chain and the reasoning are visible in the deliverable.
Reworked mobile as a vertical session rather than a scaled desktop, with real tap targets and a compact transport.

material.fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.04–0.10) linear gradient over the ambient room
material.rim: 1px gradient rim — white 33% → cool 13% → lamp 13% → white 13%
material.rule: Glass is for instruments and controls, never for article body. One accent per view.

motion: Lenis inertia scroll feeds GSAP ScrollTrigger for the section handoffs.
Motion handles stagger and dialog transitions; the audio provider never unmounts.
The hero analyser drives the waveform bars and the ambient bloom intensity while playing.
The dock contracts to the bottom pill after the hero; reduced-motion keeps the static frame.
